Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Stripe is building the economic engine for AI – and it’s working. Today, 88% of the Forbes AI 50 are building on Stripe (and most of the remaining 12% are pre-monetization).
The AI GTM team is focused on helping AI-native businesses monetize and scale. We're in a unique position—partnering with the world's most ambitious AI companies (like OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, and NVIDIA) to help them grow. This is one of the fastest growing parts of the business, and we need more great people to help us continue to accelerate.

As a Sales Manager on the AI GTM team at Stripe, you will leverage your sales leadership and product expertise to drive growth through new and existing strategic AI customers. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer of AI, you will lead a team of Account Executives responsible for expanding Stripe's relationship with some of the most important AI companies in the world—across payments, billing, and beyond.
You will be instrumental in leading in-depth product discussions with customers, developing consultative and solution-based sales strategies, and building deep knowledge of the AI industry and its unique monetization challenges. You will collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Product Marketing, and User Operations teams to develop and execute against our go-to-market strategy.

Develop the long-term vision for a growing AI GTM team and scale day-to-day operations.
Lead and manage a team of Account Executives managing existing AI accounts (driving revenue expansion, product attach, and retention) and looking for new business opportunities. Establish strategic plans and objectives to drive growth across the AI GTM business line, guiding execution to KPIs.
Build and develop a high-performing team, fostering a strong culture of energized and engaged Stripes while investing in the growth and development of your team. Coach and guide the team in developing consultative and solution-based sales skills throughout the sales cycle.
Be accountable for driving revenue, increasing product attach rates, and growing existing clients at high rates.
Engage with Product, Marketing, and User Operations teams to influence our product roadmap (you are on the frontier!) and accelerate our growth trajectory for our AI industry users.
Serve as both an internal and customer-facing expert on Stripe's products, particularly as they apply to AI-native business models (usage-based billing, marketplace payments, embedded finance, agentic commerce).
Build strong relationships with customer executives (CEO, CFO, CTO) and serve as a trusted advisor on how Stripe can support their growth.
Create best practices and improve the business and customer engagement model.

Sales leader. You are an adept sales leader, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization. You see value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require both deep product understanding and technical knowledge, especially for AI industry users.
People developer. You are a strong people leader who builds high-performing teams through coaching, accountability, and culture. You're as comfortable working with clients as with internal stakeholders (including executives) and are excited to become an expert and share your knowledge. You possess an organized, self-starter mindset and excellent communication skills, with a track record for improving the processes and organizations around you.
AI enthusiast. You have deep context in the AI industry and are energized by keeping up with new developments in the space. You bring a user-first mindset— you approach every customer interaction as a consultative partner rather than a transactional seller.
Technically curious. You understand APIs, webhooks, and modern developer tools—and you can hold credible conversations with engineering leaders about how Stripe's infrastructure fits into their stack.

8+ years of sales leadership experience, launching and growing high-functioning sales teams/products.
10+ years of experience in hyper-growth SaaS or technology environments across the AMER region.
Demonstrated success managing existing/growth customer portfolios and driving revenue expansion.
Proven ability to be a self-starter, capable of driving business results without significant supervision.
Ability to understand complex technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple stakeholders.
Deep understanding of AI industry dynamics, business models, and monetization strategies (usage-based pricing, API-first distribution, agentic commerce).
Strong product acumen—ability to learn and articulate complex product capabilities, understand how they work technically, and connect them to user needs.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong presentation skills for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders.
An enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality.
Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke agreements with commercial and enterprise businesses.

Industry experience in payments, financial infrastructure, developer tools, or AI/ML platforms.
Existing relationships within the AI ecosystem (AI labs, AI-native SaaS companies, developer platforms).
Experience selling complex platform solutions involving multiple products.
Prior experience at a growth-stage software company or a leading payments/fintech company.
Familiarity with Stripe's product suite and how AI companies leverage financial infrastructure to scale.
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.
We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.
Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

We are hiring a Client Success Account Manager to our Client Success team in Paraná.
This role is to join the B2B team and will be responsible for managing a key portfolio of our clients. As a Client Success Manager, you will be expected to bring significant business results to Wellhub through upselling, cross selling and renegotiation within existing accounts. This person will also work in collaboration with different areas of Wellhub to improve and evolve the client's experience.
This is a great opportunity to join a growing team in a market that is really gaining momentum on B2B business and we are excited to have a game-changer candidate to take us to the next level.

Develop a sales plan for each named client — identifying products, expansion opportunities, and the strategic rationale ("why Wellhub") — leading the client relationship for a portfolio of large and complex Enterprise accounts throughout the client lifecycle.
Ensure contract renewals, expansions, and lead annual contract renegotiations.
Partner with client's HR and decision makers, building an approach to connect their C-level to Wellhub executives (and/or executives at other clients) to broaden and deepen engagement with Wellhub.
Use data and market analysis to identify risks, opportunities, and build data-backed narratives to support negotiations and retention strategies.
Provide product feedback (client requirements, product shortcomings, enhancements, etc.) to product management.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

Based in Paraná — hybrid model, with in-person client visits.
Previous experience in a client-facing role, leading large and complex Enterprise client relationships, with proven cross-selling and upselling results in an existing portfolio.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data to support decision-making, negotiations, and client strategy.
Strong communication skills to engage with senior stakeholders, including Director and C-level audiences.
Ability to identify root causes and solve problems creatively and efficiently.
Ability to operate independently and manage multiple clients/projects concurrently with strong attention to detail.
Able to analyze and improve current processes/protocols and anticipate/manage change in a fast-moving global business environment.
Highly proficient in English.
We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience managing large and complex Enterprise client portfolios and advanced proficiency in English, are mandatory requirements.

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.
Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.
WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.
HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.
FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.
FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.
PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!
PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.
CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.
CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.
Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube !
Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025!
This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here.
Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub
We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.
Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

About Zscaler
Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise , we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.
Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats.

We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate —we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession , collaboration, ownership, and accountability.
We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.
The Zscaler Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing their expertise to lead a secure, cloud-enabled digital future and further cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.

Sales, Customer Success, Sales Enablement, Solution Architects, Business Development, Transformation, and Technology Partnerships all work together to demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation to the world.
We're looking for an Account Executive, Majors based in Massachusetts metro to join our East team. Reporting to the Regional Director, you will:
Build relationships with important internal and customer stakeholders, including c-suite decision-makers
Create a long-term account strategy aligned with customer goals
Collaborate with our teams to meet customer needs and contribute to account planning
Be a trusted advisor, understanding client businesses and aligning Zscaler solutions with their goals

Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving"
10+ years of full-cycle sales experience within software or security industry
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
Progressive selling experience engaging with accounts and selling at C-Level
Demonstrate curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

Role
We are looking for an Account Executive to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Germany, reporting to the Sales Director in the Enterprise sales department. The Zscaler Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers and driving a secure, cloud-enabled digital future.

In this role, you will take ownership of an assigned territory to demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation and further cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.

Take ownership of an assigned territory in Germany focused on net new logo and up-sell opportunities with Enterprise prospects and customers
Demonstrate expertise in building business cases that clearly show value and differentiation at all levels of your customer and prospect organizations
Generate pipeline using new techniques, tools, joint field marketing initiatives, and top-tier channel partners including VAR, SI, and SP

You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
3+ years of sales experience with a revenue quota, selling to Enterprise accounts in Germany
History of net new logo accomplishments and a clear understanding of how to leverage channel partnerships
Willingness to be coached and the discipline to work a proven sales process from beginning to end
Evidence of successful "team sales" and the ability to leverage internal resources and partners
Fluency in German

Weitersagen

Du baust gerne neue Märkte auf und überzeugst Menschen von digitalen Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert?

Dann könnte diese Rolle genau zu dir passen. Für unser SaaS-Produkt STRATUS suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende und vertriebsstarke Persönlichkeit, die den Markt in der Romandie aktiv weiterentwickelt, Neukund:innen gewinnt und langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufbaut. Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales Cycle – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss und darüber hinaus.

Das bewegst du

Als Business Development & Sales Manager:in entwickelst du den Markt für unser SaaS-Produkt STRATUS – unsere digitale Lösung für das Immobilienmanagement – in der Romandie aktiv weiter. Du identifizierst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, gewinnst Neukund:innen und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Dabei gestaltest du die Marktbearbeitung eigenverantwortlich und trägst wesentlich zum Wachstum unseres SaaS-Geschäfts bei.

Du führst den gesamten Sales Cycle eigenverantwortlich – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über die Bedarfsanalyse und die Präsentation unserer Softwarelösungen bis zur Erstellung von Angeboten, Vertragsverhandlungen und dem erfolgreichen Abschluss. Potenzielle Kund:innen überzeugst du telefonisch, digital, an Fachveranstaltungen sowie persönlich vor Ort. Dabei verstehst du ihre Herausforderungen und zeigst auf, wie unsere Lösungen einen echten Mehrwert für ihr Immobilienmanagement schaffen.

Auch nach dem Vertragsabschluss bleibst du eine wichtige Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen. Du begleitest die Einführung unserer Lösung, führst Anwenderschulungen durch und unterstützt eine erfolgreiche Nutzung von STRATUS. Gleichzeitig bringst du die Erkenntnisse aus dem Markt und aus Kundengesprächen aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Lösungen und unserer Marktbearbeitung ein.

Das bringst du mit

Du verfügst über mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb – idealerweise im Verkauf von Softwarelösungen oder anderen erklärungsbedürftigen Dienstleistungen – und hast Freude daran, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen und langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen. Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, Hartnäckigkeit und Abschlussstärke zeichnen dich aus. Du erkennst Chancen im Markt, gehst aktiv auf Menschen zu und verstehst es, Vertrauen nachhaltig aufzubauen.

Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Französisch und bewegst dich sicher im Geschäftsumfeld der Romandie. Die Businesskultur der Westschweiz ist dir vertraut, und du verstehst es, Beziehungen auf Augenhöhe aufzubauen. Deutschkenntnisse sind willkommen und erleichtern die Zusammenarbeit mit der Deutschschweiz.

Du arbeitest strukturiert, nutzt digitale Tools selbstverständlich und gehst Herausforderungen mit Eigeninitiative und einer pragmatischen Hands-on-Mentalität an. Eine Aus- oder Weiterbildung im Verkauf, in der Immobilienbranche oder im betriebswirtschaftlichen Umfeld ist von Vorteil. Idealerweise wohnst du im Drei-Seen-Land oder in den Kantonen Jura oder Waadt.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Wir sind ein unabhängiges Ingenieur-, Planungs- und Beratungsunternehmen und gestalten mit innovativen Lösungen die Zukunft in den Bereichen Bau, Mobilität, Energie und strategisches Portfoliomanagement. Im Fachbereich STRATUS erwartet dich Start-up-Spirit in einem etablierten Expertenumfeld – kollegial, wertschätzend und unkompliziert. Du übernimmst viel Eigenverantwortung und gestaltest den Aufbau unseres SaaS-Geschäfts in der Romandie aktiv mit.

Wir bieten dir ein Pensum von 50 bis 100 Prozent im Jahresarbeitszeitmodell sowie Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten nach der Einarbeitung. Das flexible Pensum eröffnet bewusst auch erfahrenen Persönlichkeiten sowie Wiedereinsteiger:innen – beispielsweise nach einer Familienzeit – attraktive Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten und mobilem Arbeiten lassen sich unterschiedliche Lebensmodelle gut mit dem Berufsalltag vereinbaren.

Darüber hinaus profitierst du von einer attraktiven Pensionskassenlösung, ÖV-Vergünstigungen wie GA oder Halbtax, einer Mensa beziehungsweise Cafeteria sowie regelmässigen Teamevents. Gezielte interne und externe Weiterbildungen unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Das zeichnet uns aus

Bei uns begegnen sich junge und erfahrene Fachpersonen auf Augenhöhe. Wir pflegen eine Kultur des gegenseitigen Respekts und eine unkomplizierte, prestigefreie Atmosphäre.

Als Team entwickeln wir unser SaaS-Produkt und unsere Marktbearbeitung kontinuierlich weiter. Wir teilen unser Wissen proaktiv, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und arbeiten eng zusammen, um für unsere Kund:innen praxisnahe digitale Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert zu entwickeln. Eigeninitiative, kurze Entscheidungswege und der Wille, gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein, prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit.

The Key Account Manager (KAM) for Appliance & TV is a strategic commercial role dedicated to driving the growth, revenue, and market share of Jumia’s home appliances and television portfolio (including major domestic appliances, small kitchen electronics, and smart TVs).

Acting as the primary commercial link, this role is responsible for managing high-value relationships with top global consumer electronics brands, regional distributors, and local appliance vendors.

By analyzing consumer electronics market trends and securing competitive pricing, exclusive range launches, and stock availability, the KAM ensures that Jumia remains the preferred destination for home appliance and TV shoppers.
What you will be doing
Vendor & Account Management: Manage key accounts, top brands, and distributors within the Appliance & TV category to build strong, long-lasting commercial partnerships.
Commercial Growth: Develop and implement category-specific commercial strategies to scale sales volume, maximize revenue, and grow Jumia's appliance and TV market share.
Campaign Execution: Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to create and execute high-impact promotional campaigns (e.g., Tech Week, Black Friday, Home Makeover sales) tailored to home electronics consumers.
Market Analysis: Analyze sales data, stock turn, and consumer electronics market trends to identify growth opportunities, gap assortments, and competitive pricing strategies.
Performance Tracking: Monitor and report on core category metrics, including GMV, stock health/inventory levels, and vendor operational fulfillment.
Commercial Negotiations: Lead commercial negotiations to secure exclusive product launches, best-in-market pricing, and optimal margin contributions from appliance and TV vendors.
Vendor Support: Provide proactive business support to key partners, resolving operational bottlenecks and tracking their growth on the platform.
Industry Expertise: Stay deeply updated on global and local consumer electronics trends, display technologies (e.g., OLED, QLED, Smart OS), energy-efficiency standards, competitor positioning, and shifting consumer home preferences.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Work closely with operations, logistics, and content teams to ensure seamless inbound scheduling for heavy and bulky goods, stock availability, and high-quality product listings.

Professional Experience: Minimum 2 years of proven commercial or account management experience, ideally within the e-commerce, consumer electronics, or home appliance retail industries.
Category Expertise: A strong understanding of the Appliance & TV category, including deep knowledge of home electronics specifications, major vs. small domestic appliances, display tech, and brand positioning.
Commercial & Negotiation Skills: Sharp commercial acumen with excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills to secure premium deals with major appliance and TV brands.
Analytical Capabilities: Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with proficiency in Excel and data tools to monitor inventory health, sales targets, and market trends.
Strategic & Results-Driven: Ability to think strategically and execute actionable commercial plans that consistently drive category GMV and growth.
Agility & Drive: A proactive, self-motivated approach with the ability to thrive, prioritize, and multi-task within a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

About Cytix
Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.
That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.
We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.
Make the first move . When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.
Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.
See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.
Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.
Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

s.h: THIS IS A REAL STEP INTO CLOSING

You booked the meeting. Someone else closed it. Not here.
Your number. Your accounts. Your calls. Your deals. Start to finish.
You already know this feeling
You worked the account for weeks. You found the pain, you got the right person on the phone, you booked the meeting. Then you handed it over and watched someone else take it to signature and pick up the commission.
This is the seat where you keep it.

You own a UK and Ireland mid-market patch and carry a monthly new-business ARR target. You find every opportunity yourself, and you close it yourself. There is no SDR underneath you and nobody filling your diary. We give you the data, the tools, the coaching and a few live opportunities to get you moving. Everything after that is yours to build.
If that reads as a warning, this is not your role. If it reads as an opportunity, keep going.
What you’ll actually be doing
Picking your target accounts and going after them properly
Cold calling. Every week. It does not stop being part of the job when you start closing
Running discovery that reaches business impact, not a feature checklist
Demoing Joblogic to operations directors, finance and business owners
Multi-threading, building the commercial case, negotiating and closing
Keeping HubSpot honest and forecasting a number you are happy to be held to

A structured 90-day ramp into discovery, demonstrations, commercials and closing. You will never be guessing what good looks like
Full coaching as standard: MEDDPICC is our qualification standard and we will teach it to you, alongside discovery, demo and negotiation training, weekly call reviews and deal clinics
Live opportunities at the start to get you selling while you build your own engine
The data, tooling and tech stack to prospect properly, so your time goes on selling rather than list building
A real career, with a fast-growing, PE-backed software business scaling to £100M ARR. This is the first seat of a career here, not the last
You’ll love this if
You have 12-36 months as an SDR or BDR and you have smashed your number, and you can prove it with real figures
A cold call that turns into a deal is still the best part of your week
You are competitive with yourself before you are competitive with anyone else

Your best answer to “how did you perform?” is “the team hit target”.

We are the UK’s #1 Field Service Management software platform. Contract Negotiation: Lead contract negotiations, ensuring favorable terms for both the client and the company.

5+ years experience selling to large, complex F100 businesses, demonstrating a successful track record of meeting or exceeding targets, preferably in a similar industry or role.
Demonstrated ability to communicate, present, and influence credibly and effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.
Experience delivering client-focused solutions to customer needs.
Proven ability to manage multiple account management projects at a time while maintaining sharp attention to detail.
Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation abilities.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Above and beyond: Trained in Command of the Message and MEDDPICC
What to expect

Understanding the Company and Product : Gain a deep understanding of the company's products or services, value proposition, and the competitive landscape. This includes completing all necessary onboarding training and familiarizing oneself with the company culture and processes.
Relationship Building : Begin to establish relationships with key internal stakeholders, including sales, marketing, product, and customer support teams. Understanding their roles and how they can contribute to the success of strategic accounts is crucial.
Client Familiarization: Start to get acquainted with the portfolio of strategic accounts, including reviewing account histories, previous interactions, and current contracts or agreements. Initial meetings with some key clients may also take place to introduce yourself as their new point of contact.

Strategic Planning: Develop detailed strategic plans for each key account, identifying opportunities for growth, potential challenges, and strategic objectives. This should be done in collaboration with clients and internal teams.
Performance Metrics: Establish clear KPIs for success within your accounts, aligned with both client expectations and company goals. Begin tracking these metrics closely.
Sales and Negotiations: Start actively pursuing new business opportunities within strategic accounts, which may involve negotiating terms for contracts or renewals. Efforts to cross-sell or up-sell should also be underway.
Feedback Loop: Implement a process for regularly gathering and acting on client feedback to improve service delivery and client satisfaction.

Achieving Sales Targets: By the one-year mark, you should have met or exceeded the initial sales targets set for your strategic accounts. This includes successfully closing new deals and expanding business within existing accounts.
Strategic Account Growth: Demonstrated growth in strategic accounts through increased engagement, higher revenue, and enhanced partnership levels. Your strategic planning and execution should result in tangible benefits for both the clients and your company.
Relationship Depth: At this point, you should have established deep, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders within each strategic account. You're seen as a strategic advisor rather than just a sales contact.
Process Improvements: Identification and implementation of process improvements based on lessons learned over the year to increase efficiency, customer satisfaction, and sales effectiveness.
Professional Development : Continued professional growth, possibly including leadership development, advanced sales strategies, and industry knowledge enhancement to better serve strategic accounts and contribute to the company's objectives.
Success in an Account Executive Strategic role is measured not just by sales figures but by the depth of relationships built, the strategic value delivered to clients, and the positive impact on the company’s long-term growth. Regular reviews against these expectations can help in identifying areas for improvement and adjusting strategies as necessary.

Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar
Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina . Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven , creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.
Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal , reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones .
Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.
Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.
Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, ingresa a: grupoquintoandar.com/es/
Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo
Nuestro equipo de Key Account Manager trabaja bajo el modelo “híbrido”, siendo necesario estar presencialmente en la oficina, ubicada en Buenos Aires, 2 veces por semana.
Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío
El Hunter de Expansión es un perfil netamente estratégico y de apertura de mercado. Su misión principal es desembarcar y consolidar la presencia de la compañía en nuevas zonas geográficas, nuevas plazas o verticales de negocio no exploradas (como abrir nuevas zonas en GBA o penetrar el modelo híbrido en el interior). No maneja cartera existente; su foco es el crecimiento desde cero,
Tus Responsabilidades
Apertura de Nuevas Plazas: Liderar la estrategia de entrada comercial en nuevas geografías, mapeando competidores locales y detectando barreras de entrada.
Captación Agresiva (Paid Publisher): Introducir los modelos de monetización y planes premium de la compañía en el nuevo mercado, logrando los primeros cierres clave.
Generación de Demanda Local: Desarrollar relaciones sólidas desde cero con los principales actores del mercado objetivo (inmobiliarias locales, desarrolladores)
Alianza con Operaciones: Trabajar de la mano con los equipos de producto y marketing para adaptar el discurso comercial a las particularidades culturales y económicas de la nueva plaza.
Growth Comercial: Asegurar que la nueva plaza alcance la masa crítica de listing o facturación necesaria en los plazos estipulados por el Business Plan (BP).
Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)
Experiencia: Mínimo 3 a 5 años en roles de desarrollo de negocio ( Business Development ), ventas corporativas de campo (territoriales) o expansión en empresas de tecnología/proptech.
Habilidades Blandas: Autonomía extrema, pensamiento estratégico, visión de negocio, adaptabilidad al cambio y habilidades de comunicación a nivel ejecutivo.
¿Cómo es nuestro Proceso de Selección?
Diseñamos un proceso transparente, directo y enfocado en evaluar tu potencial técnico y comportamental, dándote la oportunidad de conocer a nuestros equipos y rutas de carrera:

About Semarchy Semarchy helps enterprises master, govern, and put their data to work through a unified Data Platform spanning Master Data Management, data quality, and data governance, deployable natively inside Snowflake or as SaaS. Our customers use Semarchy to bring order to data spread across dozens of systems and turn it into something they can trust for reporting, operations, and AI.
The RoleWe're hiring an Account Executive for our AMER Enterprise team. You'll own a full-cycle book of business, from qualifying inbound and self-sourced pipeline through discovery, solution development, demo, negotiation, and close. Our deals are consultative and multi-stakeholder: you're rarely selling to one person, and the technical conversation is usually a proxy for a business one underneath it.
Ownership doesn't end at signature. You'll build the account plan, hand off cleanly to Professional Services and Customer Success, and come back in to lead the commercial conversation when it's time to expand, renew, or move an existing customer onto our newly upgraded platform. Responsibilities

Build pipeline. Generate and qualify opportunities through inbound requests, closed-lost revisits, referrals, and your own outbound. Keep Salesforce and Gong current as deals move, not just at quarter-end, so your forecast holds up two months out.
Run discovery that gets past the ticket. Uncover the prospect's high-level company goals, bring company and industry context into the call, and get past the technical and personal pain to the real organizational stakes: what happens if nothing changes, and why that matters to the business.
Multi-thread the deal. Identify who else needs to be in the room and bring them in deliberately, rather than waiting for the prospect to volunteer them.
Shape the solution. Understand what the prospect thinks they need, and know when to introduce a requirement they haven't asked for yet, whether that's a related module or the specific reason we're the better fit against the alternative they're evaluating.
Partner with your SC on a demo that sells the pain, not the feature. Own the value narrative and coordinate the technical demo with your Solutions Consultant, who leads it. Tie what's shown back to what the prospect named in discovery, and give your SC the lead time they need to prep, especially when a demo gets booked with less than a day's notice.
Negotiate a real plan. Know which agreement you need next given where the deal actually is, and leave every call with a specific next step, a date, and a named owner on both sides.
Build a business case your champion can carry into their own organization, tied to the financial and operational impact you uncovered together.
Manage the process to close, tracking the paper, security review, and approvals that sit between a verbal yes and a signature.
Own the account plan and the handoff. Build the plan for your named accounts, lead a clean handoff to Professional Services and Customer Success at close, and stay the commercial owner for expansion, renewal, and platform-transition conversations in your book.

A track record closing complex, multi-stakeholder software deals, ideally in data, analytics, or platform categories.
Comfort running a structured sales process while staying present and conversational. The framework should make the conversation feel more natural, not scripted.
Directness balanced with warmth. You can name a stalled buy-in or an unrealistic timeline out loud, in a way that keeps the relationship intact.
Genuine curiosity about the prospect's business, not just their tech stack. You ask a second and third “why,” and you're comfortable letting a call go somewhere your outline didn't predict.
Coachability. You take feedback, apply it, and can name your own gaps before someone else does.
A collaborative style, especially with your SC. You don't need deep technical fluency on day one; you need the instinct to loop your SC in early and work the deal together, not around them. You also bring in deal desk, partners, and leadership early.
Ownership. You flag a deal risk before it becomes a surprise, and you show up with a plan alongside it.
Judgment about where your time goes. With a growing book, you know which two or three accounts genuinely need you this week and protect the rest of your time for the next deal.

Experience selling into Snowflake or Databricks ecosystems.
Familiarity with MDM, data governance, or data quality, or the track record to get there fast.
Experience competing against vendors like Informatica or Reltio.

Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions.

From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team.

World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.

Our Senior Account Executive, Enterprise team partners with prospective customers of 5,000 to 10,000 employees, owning the full deal cycle from first conversation to signed contract. We are product experts and ambassadors for Outreach, building deep knowledge of our customers' goals and pain points so they can create and close pipeline through the Outreach Sales Execution Platform.
We enjoy learning new sales trends and methodologies, going to industry events, subscribing to blogs and podcasts, reading books, and researching case studies so we can grow together. We work closely to champion our customers, share success stories, and celebrate our wins.

The primary purpose of a Senior Account Executive, Enterprise at Outreach is to lead complex, full-lifecycle sales strategy for net new, prospect accounts. You are accountable for developing account plans, using the MEDDPICC sales methodology to build new business and achieve your territory goals. You identify and deeply understand a prospect's needs, pains, and desired business outcomes, then build an effective business case that demonstrates the ROI and value of the Outreach platform.

You will partner with other members of the go-to-market team, such as Solutions Consultants, to guide prospective customers through proof of concept demos. Your primary points of contact are executive stakeholders (CRO, COO, CEO, CFO, and CISO).

Key performance indicators include quota attainment, pipeline generation and coverage, and forecast quality and accuracy.
We are an AI-forward team, using intelligent tools to research accounts, sharpen discovery, and build business cases faster than the market moves. We are looking for sellers who bring that same mindset to the C-suite, helping prospects see how Outreach's AI-powered platform turns their pipeline into predictable revenue.

Territory and Pipeline: Identify, research, and qualify potential new customers in your assigned territory, building pipeline coverage sufficient to achieve your sales targets.

After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. The Toast Retail platform is already winning with independent operators. Now we are moving upmarket, and this is one of the key sales roles that proves the commercial motion as we pursue increasingly complex retail accounts.

As a founding Mid Market Account Executive for Toast Retail, you will source and close multi-location retail deals with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. These are complex accounts with real buying committees, layered compliance requirements, deep inventory and SKU demands, and incumbent systems that took years to entrench. Winning them requires a sales motion that does not fully exist at Toast Retail yet. You will help build it, one deal at a time.
This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a finished playbook. Some proof points exist from our SMB business, leadership is investing, and there is a set of open questions that closers in the field have to go answer. What does discovery look like when the buyer is a VP of Operations and not an owner?

Which SMB motions translate upmarket and which have to be rebuilt? What do we need from Product to be credible in a 40 store grocery chain? You will form hypotheses, test them in live deals, and feed what works back so the next AEs can run it.
You will report to the Manager, Mid Market Sales, Toast Retail. This is a remote opportunity with travel expectations of 30% or more, including store walks and on site visits.

Pipeline and prospecting: Build a qualified pipeline of multi-location grocery, liquor, and convenience operators through category research, cold calling, networking, and close partnership with our SMB Retail teams to identify accounts ready to move upmarket.
Retail centric discovery: Run disciplined discovery against buying committees rather than single owners. Learn the operational realities that move a category buyer, from inventory depth and scan data to shrink, margin, and compliance, and turn them into a compelling case for Toast Retail.
Value based selling: Create demand by educating prospects on the Toast Retail value proposition through demonstrations and tailored business cases. Sell on platform value and outcomes over price, and help operators understand which products actually fit their scale.
Full lifecycle ownership: Own the entire journey, from lead development and financial structuring to contract negotiation and close. Collaborate with Account Service and Implementation to ensure a seamless handoff on retail installs that are meaningfully harder than a single site.
Complex deal navigation: Manage lengthy sales cycles with real ambiguity. Multithread across operations, finance, IT, and merchandising, and develop champions inside layered retail organizations.
Internal collaboration: Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Biz Ops, and Finance to structure deals, and hold your ground in negotiations so terms align with Toast's goals. Work with Product, Marketing, and Enablement to close the gaps between us and a repeatable Mid Market Retail motion, and escalate the ones you cannot close yourself.
Build as you close: Convert what works in your live deals into discovery notes, demo flows, and business case models the next AEs can run. Distinguish a repeatable process from a one off hero deal, and help codify the former.
Voice of the retailer: Bring the Mid Market retailer's needs back into the product roadmap with specificity and evidence, not anecdotes.
Revenue mindset: Optimize for long term realized revenue, not just bookings. Evaluate the full financial impact of every deal, ask what it will actually cost us, and make thoughtful trade offs on pricing, discounts, and terms while protecting Toast's bottom line.
Operational excellence: Maintain high standards of execution, prioritization, and follow through in Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack, and help establish the conversion benchmarks that do not exist yet.

THE JOB Warum mute-labs? Bei mute-labs gibt es weder „VC-getriebenen Burnout“ noch toxische Sales Floors. Wir sind ein eigenfinanziertes, nachhaltig profitables Team mit einer klaren Mission: mehr Ruhe in die lautesten Büros der Welt zu bringen.
Wir entwickeln und produzieren hochwertige Akustikboxen, die wirklich zu modernen Arbeitswelten passen.
Dabei verkaufen wir nicht einfach nur „Boxen“ – wir verkaufen Fokus, Produktivität und ein besseres Arbeitsumfeld.
Für den DACH-Markt suchen wir einen Full-Cycle BDR , der den gesamten Sales-Prozess selbst in die Hand nehmen möchte – vom ersten „Hallo“ bis zum finalen Handshake.
Die Rolle: Beratung statt einfach nur telefonieren Bei uns liest Du kein vorgefertigtes Skript ab. Du berätst Unternehmen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz dabei, bessere Arbeitswelten zu gestalten.
Qualifizierte Inbound Leads: Vergiss wahlloses „Smile and Dial“. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für hochwertige Leads – Unternehmen, die bereits echtes Interesse an unseren Produkten haben.
Pipeline-Aufbau: Du identifizierst relevante Entscheider:innen wie Facility Manager, HR Leads oder Founder und baust eine Pipeline auf, bei der Qualität wichtiger ist als reine Quantität.
End-to-End Ownership: Du identifizierst potenzielle Kund:innen, führst Discovery Calls und Demos durch und schließt Deine Deals selbst ab. So siehst Du am Ende ganz konkret, wie Deine Arbeit in Form einer mute-labs Box im Büro des Kunden steht.
Kein Ellenbogen-Sales: Bei uns gibt es keine Provision. Warum? Weil wir möchten, dass Du das tust, was für den Kunden und das Team am besten ist – nicht das, was Deinen Bonus maximiert. Stattdessen bieten wir ein wettbewerbsfähiges, stabiles Fixgehalt, weil wir auf Deine intrinsische Motivation setzen.
So könnte Dein Tag bei uns aussehen Wir leben eine Office-First-Kultur . Wir glauben, dass die besten Sales-Ideen bei einem gemeinsamen Kaffee entstehen – und nicht in endlosen Slack-Threads.
09:00 | Morning Vibe: Du kommst in unser energiegeladenes Office in Berlin-Mitte, holst Dir einen Kaffee, checkst die neuesten Leads und planst Deinen Tag.
09:30 | Action Phase: Du bist am Telefon oder im Video-Call, sprichst mit neuen Leads über ihre Office-Herausforderungen und vereinbarst Demos.
11:00 | Strategy Huddle: Kurzer Austausch mit Alvaro, unserem Country Manager, oder Jarno, unserem Sales Director, zu einem konkreten Deal oder einem Markttrend, den Du entdeckt hast.
12:30 | Family Table: Wir essen gemeinsam. Freitags kocht ein Team für die ganze Firma. Ob Pasta, Tacos oder ein persönlicher Klassiker – beim gemeinsamen Mittagessen kommen wir als Team zusammen.
14:30 | Market Mastery: Du führst Discovery Demos. Dabei hörst Du mehr zu, als Du redest, und findest heraus, wo beim Kunden wirklich der Schuh drückt.
18:00 | The Close: Du bringst Dein CRM auf den neuesten Stand, aktualisierst Deine Pipeline und machst Feierabend. Deine Offline-Zeit respektieren wir.
Pulse & Pints Friday Jeden Freitag lassen wir die Woche gemeinsam ausklingen.
The Pulse: In unserem Team-Huddle schauen wir auf die Zahlen, teilen Company Updates und feiern Kolleg:innen, die in dieser Woche besonders viel bewegt haben.
The Pints: Danach starten wir gemeinsam ins Wochenende – mit Drinks, alkoholisch oder 0,0 %, und dem guten Gefühl, gemeinsam etwas erreicht zu haben.
Unser Bewerbungsprozess: Schnell & transparent Wir wissen, dass gute Kandidat:innen gefragt sind – deshalb lassen wir Dich nicht wochenlang warten.
The Spark: Ein kurzer Screening Call mit Lia , um herauszufinden, ob unsere Werte und Vorstellungen zusammenpassen.
The Market Fit: Ein Deep Dive mit Alvaro (Country Manager) und Jarno (Sales Director), bei dem es um Deine Sales-DNA geht.
The Commercial View: Ein Gespräch mit Leah (Head of Commercial) über unsere Wachstumsstrategie und Deine Rolle darin.
The Live Action: Ein Discovery Role Play mit dem Team. Keine Hausaufgabe, keine tagelange Vorbereitung – wir möchten einfach sehen, wie Du ein echtes Kundengespräch führst.
The Vision: Ein finales Gespräch mit unserem CEO , in dem es um das große Ganze und Deine Entwicklung bei mute-labs geht.
Erkennst Du Dich wieder? Self-Driven Hunter: Du brauchst keinen Provisionscheck, um ambitioniert zu bleiben. Du willst Deine Ziele erreichen und das Unternehmen aktiv mit voranbringen.
Native Communicator: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kannst Dich sicher und überzeugend im DACH-Markt bewegen.
Full-Cycle Mindset: Du magst sowohl den Reiz, neue Leads zu finden, als auch das gute Gefühl, einen Deal selbst zum Abschluss zu bringen.
Team Player: Arbeiten in Silos ist nichts für Dich. Du möchtest Erfolge teilen, voneinander lernen und Deine Kolleg:innen genauso bei ihren Deals unterstützen wie bei Deinen eigenen.
Bereit, mehr Ruhe in die Arbeitswelt zu bringen? Wenn Du nach einer Sales-Rolle suchst, in der Du als Profi behandelt wirst, von einem starken Team unterstützt wirst und in einer offenen, ambitionierten Office-Kultur arbeiten möchtest, dann wollen wir Dich kennenlernen.
Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir melden uns schneller bei Dir, als Du denkst!

We’re “no tech” : We know how to develop and sell great hardware products with a focus on sound-insulated phone- and meeting booths .
We have no investors and we really don’t want any. We've been profitable since day one.
We continue to have a steep growth curve – not in employees or coffee cups consumed, but in revenue and profit.
We’re not striving for an exit – we’re building a sustainable business for many generations to come.

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:
Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
Hiring Manager Call: 45 mins to meet with Sales leadership, here they will look to discuss your experience and relevance in greater detail. Understanding strengths and weaknesses.
Pleo Challenge: A 60 mins, here we look to dive deeper. This interview will be split into 2 sections 30 min mock Discovery Call, and a 15 min Pleo presentation as an Account Executive with 15 min Q&A.
Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!
Last time we hired an Account Executive, we received a total of 120 applications but only 15 were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:
CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light.

What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on.

A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.
We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
Our vision is to transform presentations, meetings and lectures by turning passive audiences into engaged contributors. We make this possible through our interactive presentation platform where the traditional presentation monologue becomes an inclusive dialogue. We believe in the power of together and that the most successful leaders listen to be heard.
With Mentimeter, users become the best presenter they can be. Meetings become more productive, participants learn more and have fun whilst doing it.
We have more than 300 million users and customers worldwide, on our way of making the world a better place, one presentation at a time.
As an Account Manager, you will lead the expansion of our existing Enterprise customers by focusing on revenue growth through renewals and up-sales while serving as a trusted adviser to our customers.
We expect you to have an entrepreneurial tempo with the main focus on commercial initiatives to drive revenue growth among our Enterprise customers. We are looking for someone who can create long-term and strategic relationships with out customers.
We use the theory of Predictable Revenue, and reference Dropbox and Slack when we see the future of Mentimeter. Mentimeter is a service that is loved globally and our growth has been almost 100% organic. Sales are currently growing over 10% per month and you will be the driving force to accelerate that growth even further.

Full commercial ownership of our current enterprise customers
Drive revenue growth by building a strong pipeline and expanding our customers. Your success is measured on Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
Manage a continuous pipeline for new expansion and up-sell opportunities
Build long-term, strategic relationships with customers all over North America
Ownership of renewals of ongoing agreements in order to prevent churn
Ability to assess business opportunities and use data in order to support decision-making towards customers
Develop a strategy for best-in-class scalable customer expansion and customer success
Collaborate together with Customer Success Managers on strategic enterprise customers in addition to working with other sales roles on a day to day basis
Work closely with the marketing and product team by serving as the voice of your customers as well as listening to the market needs

Day-to-day support (We have minimal support, and a support specialist is responsible for this)

s.t:

Marketing and Sales team to support in analysis and tactics
Sales Development Representatives to support in lead qualification
Sales Operation function
Professional CRM and data gathering services (Intercom, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, Salesforce)

Experience of 1+ years with high volume / transactional sales working with a CRM platform
Experience in selling SaaS
Ability to assess business opportunities and use data to make informed decisions and persuade others
Passion for building long-term relationships as well as driving commercial initiatives with customers
Knowledge of software contract terms and conditions with the ability to create fair transactions
Strong negotiation, pipeline and forecasting skills
Ability to manage a large number of customers simultaneously while positioning company products against direct and indirect competitors
You are required to have professional-level English
Excellent communication skills
Permitted to work & live permanently in Toronto, ON. (This is a hybrid role, which requires you to be in office 3 days a week)
Bachelor or masters degree (field not important)

We strongly believe in the power of togetherness, and we put a lot of effort into collaboration, teamwork and helping each other whenever needed. We believe that every part of Mentimeter, from Sales Development Representatives and Account Executives to Frontend Developers and Marketing Managers contributes equally to our continued success.

To foster and emphasize this culture and way of working, we apply a non-commission based salary model in our sales roles, which has proven to be very successful and appreciated across the team. The salary band for this role ranges anywhere from $75,000 - $100,000 CAD depending on your level of experience.

s.h: You can also read about our benefits and perks here .
s.t:
What Mentimeter can offer
At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues.

We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter.

Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Once a year we also relocate to exciting places all over the world like Merida & Buenos Aires for our Toronto colleagues, cities in Europe (for our Stockholm colleagues), and cities in APAC (for our Sydney colleagues), paid for by us of course. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
Culture at Mentimeter
At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun.

We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

As an Okta AE, you will be focused on providing value to C-Suite decision makers on their ability to drive the most secure environment possible for their workforce. Holistically embrace, access, and utilize Okta partners to identify and open new, uncharted opportunities
Build and nurture effective working partnerships within your Okta ecosystem (xDRs, Partners, Presales, Customer First, etc)
Adopt a strong value based sales approach, always looking to bring a compelling point of view to each customer
Travel as necessary to build and cultivate customer and prospect relationships

Excellent communication and presentation skills with audiences of all levels and all technical aptitudes

Expertise using a Sales Framework such as MEDDICC, Challenger or Sandler (we use MEDDPICC)

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. As an Inside Sales AE, you will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate.

By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customized solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and expertise to help us build the Toast brand in your geographic territory .

Generate list of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial call to close
Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs
Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery
Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities
Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Toast in the market

1+ years of experience in a sourcing or closing sales role selling complex hardware/software solutions, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry
Strong communication, organizational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels
Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals
Experience cold-calling into various types of local businesses, with evidence of success preferred
Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment
Self-motivated, creative, and flexible
General technical proficiency with software

This is an early-in-career opportunity intended for candidates with limited professional experience.
The CSAM is an **early-in-career Customer Success Account Manager **who delivers standardized customer success outcomes spanning executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration activities. These CSAMs act within a pod model.
Working under the direction of senior CSAMs and a Manager, the CSAM operates within a defined pod covering a shared portfolio of accounts. The role contributes to portfolio-level intelligence, execution orchestration, and reactive signal aggregation - reducing context-switching for senior CSAMs and accelerating customer outcomes.
This is a talent-engine role: CSAMs are AI-first, customer-facing from month three, and grow through structured cohorts and community.

## Executive partnership and execution ##
* Execute standardized executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration tasks under direct guidance from senior CSAMs or CSU leaders.
* Support agent and Copilot adoption motions across assigned pod accounts.
* Complete assigned activities accurately and on time; escalate exceptions rather than independently diagnose them.
## Portfolio-level intelligence and preparation ##
* Maintain deep, current account context across the pod-s defined portfolio.
* Synthesize account signals into -what-s changed / what matters now-
* Detect risks, upcoming deliveries, upcoming milestones, and open threads.
* Detect portfolio patterns such as recurring blockers across multiple accounts.
## Execution orchestration (not delivery) ##
* Track delivery and milestone progress with partners and CSAs on behalf of senior CSAMs.
* Map dependencies across workloads and milestones.
* Proactively flag drift before the customer raises it.
* Coordinate remediation follow-ups across internal teams.
## Reactive signal aggregation ##
* Monitor reactive support signals - case volume, aging, repeat drivers - across the pod portfolio.
* Aggregate reactive trends into portfolio-level views and surface early warnings of escalation risk.
* Track follow-through on Support, IM, and Service Manager commitments; chase stalled internal owners.

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory.

The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.
The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts.

The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

Territory Strategy & Business Performance
Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.
Strategic Account Management & Network Development
Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow-through.
Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.
Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement
Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.
Influence & Impact
Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries
Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact
Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
Identify recurring customer, access, and patient-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Insights
Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, Analytics, and Advocacy.
Work seamlessly across field roles to coordinate account strategy, align priorities, clarify responsibilities, and ensure consistent follow-through while respecting functional boundaries.
Capture and communicate timely, objective, and actionable field insights that can inform strategy, messaging, training, resource development, customer experience, and execution priorities.
Contribute actively to business reviews, training programs, team meetings, launch readiness, and cross-functional initiatives; share best practices and support the success of the broader organization.
Entrepreneurial Drive, Resilience & Culture
Operate with a high degree of ownership, self-motivation, resourcefulness, and initiative in an unstructured, rapidly evolving rare disease environment.
Create appropriate engagement opportunities in underdeveloped accounts and markets, test new approaches, learn quickly, and translate insights into action.
Maintain sustained drive, discipline, and performance through pressure, uncertainty, obstacles, delays, and discouragement; recover quickly and remain focused on long-term goals.
Demonstrate curiosity, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning; actively seek feedback and apply coaching to strengthen clinical, strategic, and selling capabilities.

You will be part of the Business to Business team responsible for delivering significant sales growth in the B2B channel. Leveraging both personal and professional contacts in the hospitality, builder/ developer, commercial office and related industries, our team presents to and secures large volume incremental sales.

We identify and prospect daily, bringing new clients to WSI, while being Brand Ambassadors across all the WSI brands, including Pottery Barn, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Williams-Sonoma Home, and Mark & Graham.

As a Junior Account Executive, you will be responsible for driving meaningful sales growth across all WSI Brands in key areas within your assigned geographic territory with the support of Account Executives and VP of Sales.

Develop, manage, and grow the B2B client base/sales pipeline within a defined geographic territory, focusing on building relationships, and facilitating project-based solutions across all WSI Brands in partnership with territory account executive and sales director.
Manage sales at the local level, region/surrounding region, metro areas through scouting for emerging accounts and working with end users.
Proactively seek opportunities for expansion in new industry verticals.
Partner with cross-functional subject matter experts to deliver the WSI value proposition and effectively execute your sales strategy.
Develop integrated solutions through collaboration and proactive communication.
Promote WSI products and services to prospective and existing Business to Business clients through a variety of outreach opportunities to include telephone contacts, office and site visits, in-store events and tradeshows.
Conduct continuous follow-up on outstanding quotes, while pursuing new business.
Draw on industry trends and professional network to identify opportunities and creative ideas to drive business.
Effectively represent WSI through outstanding product knowledge and outstanding service. Partner with the care center support teams and corporate office partners as needed to ensure best in class service is being provided.
Develop and execute strategic business plan/sales strategy for driving sales growth across all brands.
Maintain/track your business pipeline using SalesForce.
Criteria
Minimum of 2 years’ experience in store sales, retail experience, or interior design experience
Bachelor’s degree in interior design, architecture, business administration or related subject matter.
An established book of business within the Business to Business industry with a range of relevant industry connections
A passion for furniture and interior design
Advanced product knowledge in at least two of the following categories: indoor furniture (Contract or residential), outdoor furniture, lighting, textiles, small wares/kitchen, bath/plumbing, decorative accessories, or flooring
The ability to build relationships -- both with cross functional internal partners and external
The ability to effectively manage concurrent and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
Excellent proactive, solution oriented, problem-solving skills
The ability to travel up to 30-40% of time during peak seasons include trade shows
Prior experience in business to business sales and/or retail preferred
Strong verbal and written communication skills with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with a variety of internal and external customers/clients/business partners and build strong relationships

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, to include Power Point, Outlook, and Excel
This position is remote but requires living in the Phoenix metropolitan area
